title: AI-Powered RAG Q&A Chatbot
description: A high-performance retrieval-augmented generation pipeline with document ingestion, chunking, and binary-quantized vector embedding search (est. 25-35ms retrieval latency). JS-native architecture with Groq's Kimi K2 model for low-latency, streamed responses. Currently in development.

title: Gamified Productivity Dashboard
description: A full-stack productivity app with task management, daily planning, and gamification (points, leaderboards, rankings). RESTful API endpoints across task and user modules, with MongoDB schemas designed for future feature expansion.
